name: strongman tire flip
description: Flipping a large tire end over end by driving up from a deep hinge. A full body power move that hits legs, back and chest.
instructions: Stand close to the tire and squat down, getting your fingers under its edge.
Press your chest against the tire with a flat back and hips low.
Explode up with your legs and hips, lifting the tire as you rise.
Shove the tire over with your hands and shoulders, then step in and reset for the next flip.
